papers.title: Effect of plastic strain on the solidification cracking of Hastelloy-X in the selective laser melting process
papers.first_author_affiliation: Research Center for Structural Materials, National Institute for Materials Science (NIMS), Sengen 1-2-1, Tsukuba 305-0047, Ibaraki, Japan

corresponding_authors.name: Houichi Kitano
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Research Center for Structural Materials, National Institute for Materials Science (NIMS), Sengen 1-2-1, Tsukuba 305-0047, Ibaraki, Japan

llm.relevance_to_user: 与生物医学AM方向无关，材料和应用均不涉及植入体力学或骨整合
llm.why_not_core: This paper studies solidification cracking in Hastelloy-X superalloy for aerospace, with no biomedical implant context, porous structure design, stress shielding analysis, or osseointegration testing.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究塑性应变对SLM过程中Hastelloy-X凝固裂纹的影响
summary_zh.method: 通过实验和数值模拟分析不同应变下的裂纹行为
summary_zh.result: 塑性应变增大促进了裂纹萌生和扩展
summary_zh.validation: 金相观察和有限元对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To understand the role of plastic strain in solidification cracking during selective laser melting of Hastelloy-X.
summary_en.method: Experimental characterization and finite element simulation were used to correlate plastic strain with crack density.
summary_en.result: Higher plastic strain significantly increases crack initiation and propagation.
summary_en.validation: Metallographic analysis and simulation data were cross-validated.

papers.title: Selective laser melting of tungsten: Effects of hatch distance and point distance on pore formation
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Engineering Technology and Industrial Distribution, Texas A&M University, United States

corresponding_authors.name: Chao Ma
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Engineering Technology and Industrial Distribution, Texas A&M University, United States

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究钨的选择性激光熔化工艺参数对孔隙形成的影响，与生物医学植入物或骨整合无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no stress shielding analysis, no mechanical testing (fatigue or stiffness), no surface roughness or osseointegration evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究选区激光熔化钨中搭接距离和点距对孔隙形成的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过调整工艺参数制备钨样品，并用显微CT分析孔隙特征。
summary_zh.result: 发现搭接距离和点距显著影响孔隙率及孔隙形态。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effects of hatch distance and point distance on pore formation in selective laser melted tungsten.
summary_en.method: Tungsten samples were fabricated with varying process parameters and pore characteristics were analyzed using micro-CT.
summary_en.result: Hatch distance and point distance significantly influenced porosity and pore morphology.
